title: Hill and Klocek — case comparison
summary: The cases reach different arbitration outcomes in consumer computer transactions involving terms in the box.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

Compare the applicable state law, procedural burden, evidence, offeror identity, prior notice, return period, and use of § 2-207. Which differences are factual and which reflect competing legal interpretations? Do online transactions alter the practical arguments for postponed disclosure? The book asks for reasoned positions; it provides no universal reconciliation.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
